title: Mango Sticky Rice
subtitle: Thai dessert of glutinous rice with coconut milk and fresh mango
excerpt: Mango sticky rice is Thailand's most beloved dessert. Glutinous rice is steamed until tender, then soaked in sweetened coconut milk. It is served alongside slices of ripe mango. The dish is a study in contrast -- chewy rice, rich coconut cream, and cool fresh fruit.
sourceNotes: Khao niao mamuang (mango sticky rice) is a seasonal dessert tied to the mango harvest in Thailand. It is most associated with the Nam Dok Mai mango variety, which is sweet and fibreless. The dish is sold by street vendors throughout Thailand from April to June and has become a popular Thai restaurant dessert worldwide.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: The rice must be soaked overnight before cooking.

content.text: The rice must be soaked overnight -- this is not optional. Glutinous rice will not cook through without a long soak. The rest of the dish is simple: steam the rice, warm the coconut milk with sugar, combine, and rest. The 15-minute rest after combining is what turns the rice from sticky to glossy and tender.

items.prepNote: use glutinous sticky rice -- soak in cold water overnight, then drain
use a 400ml tin of coconut milk
serve with 2 ripe mangoes, peeled and sliced alongside the rice

content.text: Drain the soaked sticky rice. Steam over boiling water in a lined steamer basket for 25 to 30 minutes until fully tender. If you do not have a steamer, cook in a saucepan with 300ml of water, covered, over very low heat for 20 minutes.
While the rice steams, warm the coconut milk in a saucepan over low heat. Add the sugar and salt. Stir until dissolved. Do not boil.
When the rice is cooked, transfer to a bowl. Pour three-quarters of the warm coconut milk over the hot rice. Stir gently. Cover and leave for 15 minutes to absorb.
Serve the sticky rice mounded alongside the mango. Drizzle the remaining coconut milk over the top.

items.symptom: Rice is hard and not tender after steaming
items.cause: Rice not soaked overnight or not steamed long enough
items.fix: Glutinous rice must be soaked for at least 8 hours before steaming -- this is not optional. Check the rice at 25 minutes by tasting a grain -- it should be fully soft with no chalky centre.

content.text: Mango sticky rice is tied to the Thai mango season. The best versions use Nam Dok Mai mangoes, which are small, yellow, and intensely sweet. Street vendors in Bangkok sell it year-round, though the summer version is the best. The coconut milk pooling around the rice is part of the pleasure.
